data.one_liner: AngularDart components that bind Bloc/Cubit state to the UI via a pipe.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BlocPipe that connects Bloc or Cubit streams to Angular templates, updating the view on state changes. Works with the bloc package to enable BLoC pattern in AngularDart apps.
use_when: You are building a web app with AngularDart and want to use the Bloc state‑management pattern.
You need a simple way to bind Bloc/Cubit state to Angular templates without writing manual subscriptions.
avoid_when: Your project is a Flutter app (use flutter_bloc or bloc instead).
You require code‑generation or advanced DI features not offered by this package.
strengths: Seamless integration of Bloc with AngularDart via a pipe.
Supports both Bloc and Cubit APIs.
weaknesses: Limited to AngularDart/web; not usable in Flutter or mobile contexts.
Frequent breaking changes tied to ngdart and bloc version upgrades.
data.setup_notes: Add angular_bloc, ngdart and bloc to pubspec, import angular_bloc.dart, and use BlocPipe in component metadata.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core Bloc package works everywhere and can be used directly without Angular‑specific glue.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar pipe‑like widgets for Flutter apps, the natural counterpart for mobile.
